messages.confirmMessage: A command in a pane asks to open an SSH connection to {destination}.
messages.proxyCommand: a proxy command from your ssh config
messages.confirmNote: It opens in a new terminal beside the caller, where you answer any password or host key prompt.
messages.integrationNote: With -t, ssh also runs {product}’s shell integration on the host for this session, so commands show as blocks: it writes a private temporary folder, sources it as the shell starts and deletes it at once. Nothing is installed and no file in your home folder there changes.
messages.helperIntegrationNote: With -t, ssh also loads {product}’s shell integration from the helper folder you installed on this host (~/.ostia/helper), after checking the file is unchanged, so commands show as blocks. If that folder is gone, a plain shell starts.
messages.denied: the human denied the connection; nothing was opened
messages.sshMissing: ssh is not on PATH; install the OpenSSH client
messages.resolveFailed: ssh could not resolve the host: {reason}
messages.timedOut: ssh -G did not answer in time
messages.sandboxed: this workspace is sandboxed: your ssh config and the network are closed off here, so ssh is not available
messages.notOpened: the terminal could not be opened ({reason})
messages.humanOnly: only the human can do this, from the command palette
messages.helperOff: the remote helper is turned off in Settings → Extensions → SSH
messages.helperRefused: you chose not to install the helper on {host}; run "SSH: Remove Remote Helper" for that host to be asked again
messages.installNote: It is a readable shell script that lists, reads and writes files only inside folders you open on this host. It runs as you, over ssh, while a remote folder is open: never with sudo, and it writes nothing of its own outside ~/.ostia. Sessions you open to this host then load their shell integration from that folder instead of a long command line. Remove it any time with "SSH: Remove Remote Helper".
messages.removeNote: It closes the remote folders open on this host and deletes ~/.ostia/helper there. You will be asked again before it is installed.
messages.helperConnectFailed: ssh could not reach the helper: {reason}. The helper connects without a terminal, so the host must accept a key or an ssh agent
messages.helperTimeout: the host did not answer in time. The helper connects without a terminal, so the host must accept a key or an ssh agent
messages.helperNeeds: the host has no {tool}, which the helper needs
messages.helperInstallFailed: the helper could not be installed ({reason})
messages.helperRemoveFailed: the helper could not be removed from the host
messages.helperProtocol: the host answered with something that is not the helper
messages.notASession: this pane is not an ssh session opened with "SSH: Connect to Host…"; focus that terminal first
messages.noRemoteFolder: the shell in this session has not reported a folder on the host yet; it needs bash or zsh with the shell integration on
messages.folderDenied: you did not open the folder
messages.remoteUsage: the remote commands take one JSON argument with host, agent, folder and step or pane
messages.nodeInstallNote: It is a readable node program that keeps your agents running in tmux on this host. It runs as you, over ssh: never with sudo, and it writes nothing of its own outside ~/.ostia. Closing a tab only detaches; the agents go on running until you stop them.
messages.nodeRefused: you chose not to install the runner on this host
messages.notRemote: this workspace is not a remote workspace
messages.pushNote: {product} pushes this one commit over ssh into a bare mirror under ~/.ostia/node/repos on the host and starts {agent} on a new branch there. Nothing is merged or checked out on this computer, and uncommitted changes never move.
messages.pushRefused: you chose not to send this repository to this host
messages.startFailed: {ref} did not start: {reason}. The job stays on the host; see it with ostia ssh remote-jobs
messages.fetchUsage: remote-fetch takes one remote job ref, as ostia ssh remote-jobs prints it: remote:<host>:<job>
messages.fetchNoFolder: the calling pane has no folder; run it from a clone of the repository
messages.fetchMessage: Fetch the branch of a job on {host} into {repo}?
messages.fetchNote: The branch is fetched into refs/remotes/ostia/<host>/<job> over ssh. Nothing is merged or checked out.
messages.fetchRefused: you chose not to fetch from this host
messages.wrongRepo: this job belongs to {repo}; run it from a clone of that repository
messages.fetchChanged: the branch on the host moved while fetching; run it again to update {ref}
messages.noChanges: the branch has no changes yet
messages.remoteDirty: job {ref} has uncommitted changes on the host; they are not in the branch. Ask the agent to commit them, then fetch again
messages.connectFailed: Could not connect to {host}. Check ssh in a terminal, then open the tab again from the Jobs list.
